resources.string: Enable ScreenOff in Accessibility settings to lock the screen without forcing a PIN on every unlock. This service only performs the system lock-screen action. It does not read screen content or monitor your interactions. After enabling it, return to ScreenOff.
Locks the screen when you open ScreenOff, without an administrator policy that forces a PIN. Does not read screen content or monitor interactions.
The ScreenOff accessibility service is not connected. Enable it in Accessibility settings, wait a moment, then open ScreenOff again.
Locking without forcing a PIN requires Android 9 or newer. ScreenOff will not use administrator locking on this device.
Android could not lock the screen. Check that the ScreenOff accessibility service is enabled, then try again.
